objective: Reduce needle/printed-tick/rim confusion and obtain calibrated reading outputs, not keypoint scores alone
scope: Offline PC development on current native HDMI images and manual-bbox ROI proxies; no board, MCU, Flash or car changes
prospective_test_H: Not opened, trained on, or evaluated
candidate_A: Existing 1202-parameter inference network, training-only weak shaft head and train-only hard false-peak suppression
candidate_B: 1009-parameter circular angular CNN, all-angle radial gray/contrast evidence around frozen CNN predicted hub; no prerequisite geometric tip
candidate_training_limit: One fixed 2400-step run per route; no automatic hyperparameter search
supervision: Direct visual hub/thin-terminal coordinates with per-head masks; weak shaft supervision explicitly limited, not manual pixel segmentation
pressure_truth_policy: Train pressure may fit angle-to-bar calibration; never reverse-infer point labels, select an angle, form inference features or fit on G pressure
roll: Image/point synchronous enhancement; runtime static-print pose from query pixels plus bbox only, no query true hub/tip/pressure; unknown pose is not zero
readout_metric: 0.05bar engineering error band; pressure setting precision is unknown
comparison: All candidates share frozen train-only calibration and G static-print pose; report all positive denominators, accepted coverage, accepted bar MAE and wrong accepted counts together
selection: Development choice only: compare correct accepted reads and wrong accepts jointly; do not optimize accepted MAE by concealing rejections, use G truth to choose a candidate needle, or call G an independent test
outputs: Candidate code and real training results
Common bar output records with source image identity
Independent checks and inference cost estimates
limits: HDMI gray is not proven identical to CSI MCU input
No expansion of existing board 0..0.51bar TEST calibration
No integer or board acceptance from floating PC results
